US-Iran Tensions Escalate Amid Ceasefire Declarations and Threats

President Trump declared a ceasefire with Iran over, threatening "1000 missiles" if assassination plots are pursued, while Iran issued warnings amid renewed hostilities. Despite the escalation, both sides have indicated a willingness to continue talks. The volatile situation has raised concerns about potential oil price spikes.
